title: Guardrails before code
summary: Set up CLAUDE.md, a quality-gates contract, hooks (secret and destructive-command guard, format and lint on edit, typecheck and tests on stop, spend and context budget guard, live cost status line, token ledger), human commit checks (husky, lint-staged, commitlint), Dependabot, CodeQL, daily API contract check, post-deploy smoke tests, a design-time threat model, a runbook and a production-readiness record, 28 tests for the guardrail hooks themselves, subagents (test-writer, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, api-scout), slash commands, ADRs and CI before writing any app code.
humanInterventions: Adam chose the problem, the stack (Next.js on Vercel) and the guardrail set.
